title: Between two deloopings of a monoid map a natural transformation is exactly an intertwiner
statement: For any Sort 1 object type A, any two AlgS.Monoid records M and N, any two functions h, h' : M.carrier -> N.carrier, and any n : N.carrier such that N.equiv (N.op n (h x)) (N.op (h' x) n) for every x, the family constantly equal to n is a natural transformation from the delooping functor induced by h to the one induced by h' (CatS.IsNat over CatS.ofMonoid A M and CatS.ofMonoid A N). CatS.ofMonoid deloops a monoid into a category whose hom-family is M.carrier, whose composition is M.op and whose hom-equivalence is M.equiv; under that reading the naturality square IS the intertwining condition, so the theorem is the hypothesis applied. The direction matters: the square reads comp (eta b) (Fm f) ~ comp (Gm f) (eta a), which under comp = op is n . h x ~ h' x . n and not its converse.

formal.statement: theorem CatS.isNat_ofMonoid : ((x0 : Sort (1)) -> ((x1 : AlgS.Monoid) -> ((x2 : AlgS.Monoid) -> ((x3 : ((x3 : AlgS.Monoid.carrier x1) -> AlgS.Monoid.carrier x2)) -> ((x4 : ((x4 : AlgS.Monoid.carrier x1) -> AlgS.Monoid.carrier x2)) -> ((x5 : AlgS.Monoid.carrier x2) -> ((x6 : ((x6 : AlgS.Monoid.carrier x1) -> AlgS.Monoid.equiv x2 (AlgS.Monoid.op x2 x5 (x3 x6)) (AlgS.Monoid.op x2 (x4 x6) x5))) -> CatS.IsNat (CatS.ofMonoid x0 x1) (CatS.ofMonoid x0 x2) (fun (x7 : x0) => x7) (fun (x7 : x0) => x7) (fun (x7 : x0) => fun (x8 : x0) => fun (x9 : AlgS.Monoid.carrier x1) => x3 x9) (fun (x7 : x0) => fun (x8 : x0) => fun (x9 : AlgS.Monoid.carrier x1) => x4 x9) (fun (x7 : x0) => x5))))))))

evidence.supports: CatS.isNat_ofMonoid admits through Kernel::add_declaration with an empty Kernel::axiom_footprint. The evaluation test the_delooping_reduces_to_the_monoids_own_fields reads the delooping's selectors out of the kernel -- hom reduces to M.carrier, id to M.e, comp g f to M.op g f and homEquiv to M.equiv -- and refuses each SWAPPED twin (M.op f g, the swapped M.equiv), so the composition order this theorem depends on is pinned rather than asserted. m3_the_naturality_square_is_indexed refuses a square with the wrong right-hand side, with its positive twin in the same test.

notes: CatS.ofMonoid is the measurement of the setoid cost at this layer, and it is ZERO: every one of the twelve CatS.Category fields is filled by one of M's own fields under dummy object binders -- homEquiv/homRefl/homSymm/homTrans by M.equiv and its three laws, compCongr by M.opCongr, idL/idR/assoc by M.identL/identR/assoc. The five fields a setoid-enriched category carries that an Eq-flavored one would get free are exactly the five AlgS already carries, so the first instance costs nothing to fill; under Eq the instance would not exist at all for a monoid whose equality is a defined relation.
